segments.comment: A Valkyrie wearing an amulet of magical breathing creates a shrieker and steps east so that it stands to her north. She puts on a blindfold and force-fights it, so its square remembers an 'I', then zaps a wand of teleportation at it; the shrieker leaves without her noticing and the 'I' stays. She wishes for a boulder, which drops at her feet, steps south, wishes a pool under herself and swaps weapons for a turn: she sinks, and display.c under_water() draws the squares around her blank. Her first step north feels the boulder; her second pushes it onto the marker's square. hack.c dopush() tests levl[rx][ry].glyph there (206-207) and unmaps the remembered 'I'; movobj()'s newsym() and feel_location() both return early for a square beside a submerged hero, so the square now remembers plain floor. She comes out onto dry land, and docrt() repaints the map from memory. The port read glyph_at(), the blank drawn glyph, kept the marker, and drew an 'I' there on the last screen. The seed, clock, character and keys were chosen for this recipe.
